evidence.dom: 【2026-07-29 決着・v9.9.41の残余刻み規約により50を確定】FY2025 10-K Item1『Competition』が市場構造そのものを述べている: 『The domestic and international markets for energy efficient products, water conservation devices, and products that address the safety and regulation for the flow of fluids, are intensely competitive and require us to compete against some companies possessing greater financial, marketing and other resources than ours. Due to the breadth of our product offerings, the number and identities of our competitors vary by product line and market』。Item1Aも『We face intense competition ... We encounter intense competition in all areas of our business』『Some of our competitors are based in foreign countries and have cost structures and prices in foreign currencies』『Competitive pressures in our markets could adversely affect our competitive position, leading to a possible loss of market share or a decrease in prices』。＝多数の競合が製品ラインごと・市場ごとに入れ替わるかたちで存在し(会社自身が『the number and identities of our competitors vary by product line and market』＝競合の数も顔ぶれも一意に特定できないと述べている)、しかもその中に自社より資源の大きい先が含まれる＝寡占構造の否定。v9.9.41: 100/85/70は集中の主張ゆえ数値(自社シェア%＋上位N社合計%)を要するが、50は残余の刻みであり、原本がこの型の構造記述を持てば数値なしで確定できる。intensely competitive で多数の競合が入れ替わる市場に自社が40%以上いることは定義上ありえない＝「競争<40%かつ上記の寡占構造に該当しない」が原本から成立する。この構造記述は『in all areas of our business』が全4製品カテゴリ(Residential & Commercial Flow Control $1,487.9M=61.0% / HVAC and Gas Products $572.1M=23.5% / Drainage and Water Re-use Products $262.1M=10.8% / Water Quality Products $116.4M=4.8%、計$2,438.5M)と全3地理セグメント(Americas 75.8% / Europe 18.5% / APMEA 5.8%)を覆っており、事業別に刻みが散らない＝空欄にする理由がない。10-K全文にシェア%(自社・上位N社とも)の開示は皆無で、順位表現は『one of the world's leading providers of water technologies and solutions』『We are a leading supplier of products and solutions that manage and conserve the flow of fluids』のみ＝v9.9.38但し書き/v9.9.41④により刻みの証拠に当たらない(50の根拠にも使っていない)。→ 自社シェア=原本開示なし／上位N社合計=原本開示なし／原本の構造記述=intensely competitive・競合は製品ラインごとに多数・自社より大きい競合が存在 → 刻み50。旧dom=70(寡占40-69%)は原本に裏付けが無かった。なお配管コードへのスペックイン・第三者認証という堀の深さはirr/rep/durが別途測っており、domでシェア支配を代用しない。出典: SEC 10-K CIK0000795403 acc 0001104659-26-018541 (FY2025-12-31) Item1 Competition / Item1A / Note4 Revenue Recognition https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/795403/000110465926018541/wts-20251231x10k.htm
